message.content: On September 19, 2026, Jennifer Moore recommended that Li Hua focus on post-workout protein intake to aid in muscle recovery. Jennifer suggested that Li Hua consume whey protein, which is excellent for muscle recovery and building lean mass. Additionally, she mentioned that plant-based options such as pea or rice protein could also be beneficial. Jennifer advised Li Hua to check the ingredients for added sugars or fillers, emphasizing the importance of choosing high-quality protein sources.
